description: Close on the burner of the great lamp, on the moment the wide shot ends. Mira's hand in a navy duffle sleeve lowers the oil can beside a box of matches; the lamp is still dark. Then she strikes a match, touches it to the wick, and the wick catches; the flame grows and the glass prisms of the lens fill with gold light.
heading: INT. LAMP ROOM - NIGHT

location.description: A round glass room at the top of the tower. The great lamp and its ring lens stand at the centre. The sea on all sides.
location.name: Lamp room

props.description: A dented tin oil can with a long spout and a brass cap.
A small box of long wooden matches.
The great lamp. A tall brass drum of ring-shaped glass prisms around a brass oil burner with a thick braided wick, on a round stone pedestal.

script:
Mira and Tomas stand on either side of the great lamp, still dark.
Mira pours the oil into the burner.
MIRA: What if it goes out?
TOMAS: Then you light it again. That is the whole job.
She sets the can down, strikes a match and lights the wick. The light grows in the lens.
MIRA: It's lit.
The beam reaches out over the sea.

look.grade: blue dusk shadows, warm lamp light, soft contrast
